data.name: Anshuman
data.gender_notes: Anshuman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ansh (supreme soul) + Manav (human) = Anshuman (God in human form). The name Anshuman carries the meaning “God in human form” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anshuman usually hope their child will grow to embody god in human form and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine presence embodied in human form
data.etymology: Anshuman belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God in human form.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anshuman total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anshuman stands symbols of divinity coexisting with humanity. It indicates that every human being has a spark of the Supreme Soul within them. This concept is deeply embedded in Hindu philosophy known as "Atman-Brahman," which denotes the interconnectedness of the individual soul and the ultimate reality (Brahman). Thus, the name Anshuman represents the harmony between the divine and the human, reflecting the rich cultural traditions and values of Indian philosophical thought.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hinduism, the ultimate goal of human life is to discover and realize the true Self, which is none other than the divine soul (Atman) that is also a part of the universal consciousness (Brahman). Anshuman, signifying the existence of supreme soul in human form, offers a constant reminder of the spiritual journey towards Self-Realization (Moksha). The name is a powerful inspiration for the pursuit of inner peace, self-discipline, and spiritual growth. The divine potential within each individual, symbolized by the name Anshuman, is a significant reminder of the spiritual potential and purpose of human existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anshuman signifies the supreme Soul (Atman) that is beyond the five senses and the five elements. It represents the pure, unchanging consciousness that dwells within every being, guiding and illuminating their journey through life.

historical_references.reference: Anshuman is mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata as the son of Bhishma Pitamaha and Vyaali. He was born when Bhishma was performing a great tapasya (penance) to obtain a powerful weapon. Anshuman was born from the divine wife of the horse given to Bhishma as a boon during his tapasya.

Anshuman is also mentioned in the Puranic literature as the son of the sage Agastya and the goddess Lopamudra. They lived in the Tripur Virahasana (hermitage of Tripurantaka) in the Himalayas. Anshuman is described as an exceptional scholar and a sage.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Anshuman, which means 'with God in heart,' has been gaining popularity in the modern context due to its unique meaning and the rise of technology trends such as AI technology, technology startups, and data analytics. Companies and individuals using platforms like Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and Google Cloud Platform for their business needs value the concept of having a strong connection to their work and their goals. Anshuman, as a name, represents this idea of being grounded and focused on achieving success while maintaining a spiritual connection. In the tech industry, where innovation and productivity are key, this name holds a special significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Anshuman, a teacher in Chennai, India, shares that their name Anshuman meaning "God in human form" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
